compressed_extraction.requirements: Use complete saved grids below the first excited target threshold and actual native energies requested_eV*0.0735/2 Hartree. Exact synthetic recovery and phase-branch invariance controls precede the data fits.

continuity_screen.pairs: Two adjacent pairs and the compressed-to-stretched pair
continuity_screen.method: Unchanged CAS(10,11)/cc-pVDZ forty-state targets. Tabulate native and PySCF thresholds by spin/irrep/root, Pi splitting and electronic flags. Evaluate core/active subspace singular values using exact cross-geometry spherical AO overlap integrals in the common saved molecular frame.
continuity_screen.controls: Same-geometry metric identity and orthogonality, reverse-overlap transpose reciprocity, finite singular values in [0,1] up to numerical tolerance, sign/within-subspace rotation invariance.
continuity_screen.interpretation: Triggers request follow-up only. Coarse geometry spacing, energy/root labels and orbital-subspace overlap cannot establish many-electron state or resonance-pole identity. Final continuity verdict stays unset.

scheduling: Recheck physical/SMT CPU ownership immediately before launch. Preserve the existing main solve, idle pilot and unrelated workloads. Fresh containers use one BLAS/OpenMP thread; larger queued imports retain their CPU-ownership guards.
preservation: Fresh diagnostic directories, immutable source/input hashes, original exits and measured resource costs. Scientific gate rejection is recorded separately from a successful diagnostic execution. No automatic fit tuning, native rebuild, large import or model/sweep release.
